scope: Future new R18 LOC explains SLICE model response; no BAG disease-decision explanation and no slice infection truth

encoder_snapshot.aggregation: eight fixed sampled slice features -> mean -> fixed train-standardized affine head
encoder_snapshot.classification_scope: BAG source category; Normal=0, COVID-19/CAP=1; not slice infection labels

current_adapter.input: one finite prepared FP32 scalar [1,1,224,224]; exact bound preprocessing before model-specific RGB normalization
current_adapter.output: raw FP32 [1,2] SLICE response logits; frozen parameters/eval mode, input gradient retained
current_adapter.admission_projection: ENC slice_contract is a helper summary, not a direct LOC validator payload: build full EPI_NEXT_EXPLANATION_TARGET_CONTRACT_V5 metadata; map verified adapter_sha256 to model_adapter_sha256; include schema, prediction_scope=SLICE, class_labels, source_label=null, model_binding, explanation_target and exact loss_definition; validate before any model call
current_adapter.truth_limit: bag training label and input differentiability do not establish slice discrimination or lesion localization

eight_slice_algebra.conditions: same frozen affine head, train-only mu/sigma, unchanged seven slices and fixed bag; z_i denotes unrounded slice logits under same head
eight_slice_algebra.precision: mathematical affine identity; ENC bag FP64 path and returned slice FP32 cast need separately bound numerical tolerance if ever compared; no new computation here
eight_slice_algebra.probability: softmax probability differences do not follow a fixed 1/8 rule
eight_slice_algebra.prohibition: BAG must not inherit old SLICE alpha/CPF rates and claim improvement from loss dilution; multiplying by 64 alone does not make different models/calibrations scientifically comparable

future_admission_and_evaluation.execution: separate exact E1/E2 comparison approval required; bind final100 head, standardization, class map, preprocessing, adapter, data/geometry and all F/B/update/time/output budgets including adaptation checks; none granted here
future_admission_and_evaluation.target: fix ORIGINAL_ARGMAX_FIXED or DECLARED_FIXED before calls; declared must equal resolved, DECLARED_FIXED may differ from prediction; report original/perturbed predicted class separately
future_admission_and_evaluation.matching: prelock same approved inputs/valid FOV, E1 16/32/64 grids, fill, area budgets, ties and same E2 core/CPF/Ls/Lm definitions; distinct per-model targets/calibration retained; no direct cross-model absolute logit-loss ranking
future_admission_and_evaluation.interpretation: SLICE CPF feasibility is an optimization-process statistic, not disease recognition or localization performance; report null candidates and all failures
future_admission_and_evaluation.reference: source-group BAG classification evaluation remains separate; no slice accuracy from bag labels. Localization reference requires independently authorized matching slice annotations and fixed area budgets; unannotated remains UNKNOWN, not automatically FP
future_admission_and_evaluation.BAG_future: a different versioned predictor/perturbation protocol must fix bag members, aggregation, target, loss scale, alpha/beta/lambda, budgets and evaluation before outcomes; current LOC v5 rejects BAG substitution
future_admission_and_evaluation.anti_selection: freeze these scope/scale/evaluation rules before new classifier evaluation; do not choose a favorable explanation protocol, thresholds, cases or seeds from future validation results

independence: E2-R uses its unchanged FrozenBaseline case3 request independently of new R18 training/evaluation. This protocol grants no new E1/E2 calls; P1 frozen, P2/P3 paused.
